an5.24:1.1: dussīlassa bhikkhave sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti sammāsamādhi
an5.24:1.2: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ
an5.24:1.3: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatupaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo
an5.24:1.4: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ
an5.24:1.6: tassa pappaṭikāpi na pāripūriṃ gacchati tacopi na pāripūriṃ gacchati pheggupi na pāripūriṃ gacchati sāropi na pāripūriṃ gacchati
an5.24:1.7: evameva kho bhikkhave dussīlassa sīlavipannassa hatupaniso hoti sammāsamādhi
an5.24:1.8: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ
an5.24:1.9: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatupaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo
an5.24:1.10: nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatupanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ
an5.24:2.1: sīlavato bhikkhave sīlasampannassa upanissayasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi
an5.24:2.2: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanissayasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ
an5.24:2.3: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanissayasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo
an5.24:2.4: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanissayasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ
an5.24:2.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno tassa pappaṭikāpi pāripūriṃ gacchati tacopi pāripūriṃ gacchati pheggupi pāripūriṃ gacchati sāropi pāripūriṃ gacchati
an5.24:2.6: evameva kho bhikkhave sīlavato sīlasampannassa upanissayasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi
an5.24:2.7: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanissayasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ
an5.24:2.8: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanissayasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo
an5.24:2.9: nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanissayasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassananti.
